# Papertrade Explorer

> Unofficial, not affiliated with Papertrade. High leverage can lose your whole margin. Read-only: nothing here signs, sends or places anything. A block-explorer-style web app and read-only MCP server for Papertrade (1000x synthetic perps on HyperEVM, chain 999).

Site: https://papertrade-explorer.pages.dev
Source: https://github.com/nirholas/papertrade-explorer (Apache-2.0)
MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no auth): https://papertrade-explorer.pages.dev/mcp
Open as a window in Papertrade OS: https://papertrade-os.pages.dev/?open=explorer

## Tools (all read-only)

- search: Search wallets, transactions, intents, positions and names.
- get_wallet: Look up a wallet.
- get_positions: Open positions valued at the live mark.
- get_intents: Pending intents of a wallet.
- lookup_intent: Follow one intent id.
- decode_transaction: Decode a HyperEVM settlement transaction.
- get_leaderboard: Ranked wallets.
- get_trade_history: Closed trades of a wallet.
- get_protocol_overview: Protocol and market overview.

## Docs (raw markdown)

- [Overview](https://papertrade-explorer.pages.dev/docs/index.md): What Papertrade Explorer is, what it can answer, and where to start.
- [Quickstart](https://papertrade-explorer.pages.dev/docs/quickstart.md): Look up a wallet in the browser, then ask your AI assistant the same question in two minutes.
- [Concepts](https://papertrade-explorer.pages.dev/docs/concepts.md): The Papertrade rules that change how every number in the explorer should be read.
- [Reference](https://papertrade-explorer.pages.dev/docs/reference.md): HTTP endpoints, the REST tool mirror, the OpenAPI description and the npm scripts.
- [MCP server](https://papertrade-explorer.pages.dev/docs/mcp.md): The read-only Model Context Protocol endpoint, its nine tools and how to call them.
- [Connect your AI](https://papertrade-explorer.pages.dev/docs/connect-your-ai.md): Copy-paste setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed, Cline, Goose, Continue and OpenAPI frameworks.
- [Agent discovery](https://papertrade-explorer.pages.dev/docs/agent-discovery.md): The machine-readable files an agent or crawler can use to find and understand this site.
- [Self-hosting](https://papertrade-explorer.pages.dev/docs/self-hosting.md): Run the explorer locally and deploy your own copy to Cloudflare Pages.
- [Security and limits](https://papertrade-explorer.pages.dev/docs/security-and-limits.md): What the explorer can and cannot do, the rate limits, and how untrusted data is handled.
- [FAQ](https://papertrade-explorer.pages.dev/docs/faq.md): Common questions about the explorer, the MCP server and Papertrade data.
- [Changelog](https://papertrade-explorer.pages.dev/docs/changelog.md): Release history of Papertrade Explorer.

## Web routes (hash routing, client side)

- /#/wallet/<address>: live balance, positions, bust distance, history, PAPER, ranks, session keys.
- /#/position/<id>, /#/intent/<id>, /#/tx/<hash>, /#/leaderboard.
- /w/<address>: server-rendered link preview for a wallet.
- Add ?embed=1 for a product-only view.
